The '''Warlord's Deep''' was the name given to one of the sections of [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. A tropical rift like the other sections of the Tomb, the Deep was linked to the nearby [[Ancient Stasis Zone]] by the [[Icewall Ravine]]. The [[signal monitoring center]] and a transporter designated the [[deep launchpoint transfer]] were located in the Deep, as was a number of Rakatan vaults.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Warlord's Deep appears a subregion of the Tomb on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
